question_id.description: Spec-maintainer questions: sm-<UTC yyyymmddThhmmssZ>-<4 hex> at QUEUE_ROOT/questions/<question_id>.json

status.description: open while unanswered; answered for resolved / not_a_spec_question; escalated for needs_operator

raised_by.description: Plane seat id that raised the question

raised_by_seat.description: Project seat name from project.yaml seats.* (e.g. wi-task-runner)

inconsistency.description: What conflicts with what, quoted briefly

tried.description: What the seat / implementer already checked

blocks.description: Task ids that cannot proceed until answered (at least task_id)

failed_calls.description: Implementation: failed maintainer calls so far (1 retry, then operational email)

lead_messaged_at.description: When the lead was sent this question (§17.3); absent on a question raised before 2026-11-05, which process sends once
